crash_console_device.description: Device file to use for debug console messages (e.g., /dev/ttyS0)

crash_log_at_init.description: If true, display kernel log buffer on startup (deprecated for kernels >= v5.10)

crash_history_size.description: Maximum number of commands to retain in history (0 = default)

crash_pager.description: Output paging command: 'less', 'more', or 'off' to disable paging

crash_smp_count.description: Explicit number of CPUs in SMP system (0 = auto-detect)

crash_arch.description: Target architecture (e.g., x86_64, arm64, ppc64, ia64, arm, x86); required for machdep settings

crash_machdep_opts.description: Machine-dependent option/value pairs for architecture-specific tuning; each entry has a 'key' and 'value' field

crash_extensions_dir.description: Directory to search for extension modules (overrides default)
